bead.title: Add verification ledger schema and strict validator
bead.description:
Purpose: create the common release evidence ledger contract before product, performance, release, and nightly suites emit evidence rows.

Required row schema: AC/INV IDs, command, exit status, backend profile, scale, seed, environment, suite, measured values, and pass-bar comparison.

In-scope files:
- crates/pqueue-service/src/verification_ledger.rs
- crates/pqueue-service/src/bin/pqueue-verify-ledger.rs
- crates/pqueue-service/tests/verification_ledger_tests.rs
- crates/pqueue-service/tests/fixtures/ledger_valid.jsonl
- crates/pqueue-service/tests/fixtures/ledger_missing_ac.jsonl
- crates/pqueue-service/tests/fixtures/ledger_missing_command.jsonl
- crates/pqueue-service/tests/fixtures/ledger_missing_exit_status.jsonl
- crates/pqueue-service/tests/fixtures/ledger_missing_backend_profile.jsonl
- crates/pqueue-service/tests/fixtures/ledger_missing_scale.jsonl
- crates/pqueue-service/tests/fixtures/ledger_missing_seed.jsonl
- crates/pqueue-service/tests/fixtures/ledger_missing_environment.jsonl
- crates/pqueue-service/tests/fixtures/ledger_missing_suite.jsonl
- crates/pqueue-service/tests/fixtures/ledger_missing_measurement.jsonl
- crates/pqueue-service/tests/fixtures/ledger_missing_pass_bar.jsonl

Out of scope: emitting product/performance/release rows; release gate scripts.
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue-service verification_ledger_tests` passes.
2. `cargo run -p pqueue-service --bin pqueue-verify-ledger -- --strict --ledger crates/pqueue-service/tests/fixtures/ledger_valid.jsonl` passes.
3. Strict validation fails with a field-specific error for each missing-field fixture listed in the description.
